title: Fail closed when the telemetry ingest schema or cron handoff validator is missing
summary: Telemetry service factory refuses to start when configured schema file is missing; ingest service validates events when default schema is present and rejects events when configured schema is unavailable; cron workflow handoff validator fails closed with RuntimeError when jsonschema is unavailable.

acceptance_verification.criterion: 1. Telemetry service refuses to start with explicit configuration error when configured ingest schema file is missing
acceptance_verification.detail: _build_service() and startup() in services/telemetry/main.py check Path(schema_path).is_file() and raise FileNotFoundError('Configured telemetry schema file does not exist: ...') instead of passing schema_path=None.

acceptance_verification.criterion: 2. Test through real telemetry service factory proves startup fails for missing schema and validates events when shipped default schema is present
acceptance_verification.detail: services/telemetry/test_ingest_schema_fail_closed.py tests _build_service() and startup() raising FileNotFoundError on missing schema, and validates event admission with shipped default schema.

acceptance_verification.criterion: 3. Cron workflow handoff validator fails closed when jsonschema is unavailable instead of falling back to required-keys-only check
acceptance_verification.detail: services/control-plane/cron/schema_validation.py raises RuntimeError('WorkflowHandoff validation unavailable: jsonschema is required') when validator is None. Tested in services/control-plane/cron/test_cron.py::TestWorkflowHandoffSchemaValidation.

acceptance_verification.criterion: 4. Default schema path shipped in telemetry image still resolves so hosted startup is unaffected
acceptance_verification.detail: Verified in l12humanops-telemetry:latest: /workspace/services/telemetry/telemetry_event.schema.json exists (-rw-rw-r--, 21994 bytes) and matches _DEFAULT_SCHEMA_PATH.

acceptance_verification.criterion: 5. No compressed code is used to meet the line budget
acceptance_verification.detail: Production code changes strictly adhere to standard formatting and reduce net production code by 15 lines (budget <= 10 lines).

validation_commands.command: docker run --rm l12humanops-telemetry:latest python -c "from pathlib import Path; import services.telemetry.main as m; assert Path(m._DEFAULT_SCHEMA_PATH).is_file()"
